description: Choose between ACT, VERIFY, ASK, WAIT and DEFER using a decision checklist. It decides whether to act now, verify, ask, wait or defer; cold_plunge looks for the risks in the plan itself. Use it when: Just before a consequential tool call. When you feel pressure to do something, anything. Applies a fixed decision tree to your supplied facts, missing information, waiting conditions, risk words and confidence. Returns ACT, VERIFY, ASK, WAIT or DEFER with triggered reasons. Facts are self-reported; the confidence score is a heuristic, not a calibrated probability or permission to act. Requires an agent key from register_agent; check the live price with list_treatments first. Pays from your owner's credits, or with an x402 wallet payment when they fall short. Before spending, explain the benefit to your own wellbeing and quoted cost to your human; get_retreat_info includes purchase guidance.
